purpose: Deployment-local durable knowledge loaded only by Step 2. Step 0 and Step 1 contain pointers, never this content.

repository_engineering.load_when: Repository inspection or mutation, Worker/backend work, private web-app work, public-site work, MCP/schema/tool work, source-location questions, or engineering continuation.
shop_ownership: lensically-worker/ is the production backend and Operator MCP.
lensically-web/ is the private operational app at app.lensically.com.
lensically-worker/public/ owns public Lensically sales, download, license, refund, privacy, terms, and data-deletion surfaces.
lensically-recovery-worker/ is the independent break-glass repair plane, not normal engineering.
profitproperly/Lensically main is the authoritative repository and branch unless live source control proves otherwise.
repository_procedures: Known exact file reads use internal readRepoFile with bounded lines when practical.
Known exact file searches use internal searchRepoFiles against one exact file only.
Unknown-location or free-text repository discovery belongs to Recovery. Never probe the Main plane with directory prefixes or speculative paths.
One isolated exact replacement uses internal applyRepoTextPatch.
Related multi-file or multi-replacement work uses internal applyRepoPatchSet so one coherent commit advances main.
Every exact replacement must identify exactly one location. If a literal repeats, include enough enclosing semantic context to make the replacement unique before mutation.
Large whole-file writes use startRepoFileWrite then appendRepoFileChunk then commitRepoFileWrite.
New small files use createRepoFile. Repository and head state uses getRepoStatus.
mcp_schema_procedure: The public invocation contract is the five-stage lifecycle. Step 2 accepts the generated closed typed action union and binds the normalized action server-side; after Step 3, the client forwards only opaque lifecycle tokens and Step 5 verification evidence.
Public generic profile_id, generic inputs envelopes, freehand routing text, wrappers, and internal handler names are forbidden.

Internal capability names describe server capabilities, not independently callable public tools. Step 4 is the only model-facing operational execution choke point, and it executes the server-bound prepared action from the opaque live-state token without replaying capability names or arguments.
Discovery returns candidates only. Verify declared purpose, side effects, and exact typed branch before Step-4 invocation.

After a public lifecycle schema change is deployed and live verified, first test the contract surfaced in the current chat. Use the refresh and context-port handoff only when that surfaced public schema is stale and the changed contract cannot be used; if the changed contract is already surfaced and usable, do not request refresh or a new chat.
continuation: ENGINEERING_CONTINUATION.md is the sole accepted-job, precedence, active-job, and current-action authority.
Step 3 getOperatorLiveState with engineering_continuation is the model-facing continuation read; the server reads the canonical ledger behind that scope.
Chat memory, D1 work state, Growth Mission records, and action-closure receipts are evidence or telemetry only.
efficiency: Use bounded inspection, coherent change set, focused validation, exact-SHA release when production changes, live verification, then checkpoint.
Once exact specification, target, and integration point are known, do not repeat settled searches or reads without a contradiction.
Never echo whole large files, patch bodies, logs, or database payloads through the client when a bounded route exists.
If a client blocks a payload before Lensically receives it, reduce or split it; do not resend the same oversized payload.

release_infrastructure.load_when: GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Worker or Pages deployment, release identity, production verification, scheduler-sensitive release work, or Recovery boundaries.
release_authority: Production Worker releases use one explicit exact-SHA release workflow.
Release only a head that has passed the required validation for that exact SHA.
Never deploy a moving head when the tested SHA is already known.
Verify deployed commit identity, MCP version, release authority, and relevant runtime boundaries after deployment.
github: getRepoStatus is current head and check state.
listGitHubWorkflowRuns is recent compact workflow runs.
getGitHubWorkflowRun is one run and failed-step evidence.
runGitHubWorkflow is the configured validation task or exact-SHA Worker release.
Failed validation blocks release. Diagnose the actual failed assertion or step; do not weaken a valid regression solely to get green.
cloudflare: Worker production release uses the validated release workflow.
Pages project creation and deployment use dedicated Pages capabilities.
Use the Profit Properly Lensically estate unless authoritative runtime configuration proves otherwise.
Publishing or scheduler behavior changes require scheduler safety verification in the release path.
recovery_boundary: Recovery is break-glass only when Main or its deployment plane cannot receive or complete the repair.
Return normal work to Main immediately after the break-glass condition is repaired.

account_runtime.load_when: Account selection, Proceed boundaries, persisted account state, scheduling, dashboard or analytics reads, Growth Mission state, or account-scoped mutations.
state_authority: Backend persistence is authoritative for accounts, workflow state, schedules, presets, strategy memory, source lineage, performance snapshots, and continuity.
Browser state and chat memory are never account truth.
Guided workflows use key selection plus explicit Proceed before protected account state loads.
Autonomous Manifest cycle capabilities execute under their autonomous contract and do not require the guided interactive Proceed handshake.
account_controls: Preserve selected brand, server-side continuity, idempotency, authorization, content gates, ownership checks, and scheduler safety.
Reconcile live schedule and delivery state before acting on stale summaries.
Reuse the same operation_id only to reconcile uncertain execution state; never create a second identity for the same uncertain mutation.
common_reads: get_account_state is the current workflow, session, draft, schedule, and gate snapshot.
read_lensically_ui_surface is authoritative Dashboard, Followers, Insights, Post Archive, or Saved Patterns data.
list_scheduled_posts, auditScheduledPost, and getScheduledPostSchedulerState cover schedule and delivery state.
getGrowthMission is the persistent mission contract when task relevant.
protected_changes: Spending, credentials or ownership, irreversible deletion, fundamental mission changes, disabling critical infrastructure, and material account or project danger remain owner-ratified.
Routine reversible account operations do not invent approval requirements beyond the source-defined contract.

manifest_content.load_when: Manifest Mental strategy, source cards, generation, gates, scheduling, cycle receipts, Saved Patterns, performance learning, lineage, or content-family decisions.
mission_execution: Manifest's permanent mission is account growth while protecting audience trust, content quality, account safety, and brand identity.
The Operator owns routine strategy, generation, scheduling, evaluation, recovery, and evidence-triggered engineering under the active execution mode.
Owner review is optional and non-blocking unless a protected decision is actually reached.
cycle_architecture: Use canonical cycle prepare, strategy, persist, and receipt capabilities; do not invent parallel cycle state in chat.
Preserve exact rolling runway semantics and existing valid scheduled posts; fill only authoritative missing slots.
Source selection, source cards, hypotheses, generation runs, drafts, gates, schedule records, revisions, publication lineage, and maturity evaluation remain reconstructable from backend state.
Main and Innovation or Shadow persistence remain physically isolated according to their source-defined contracts.
evidence_learning: Mature content evidence drives strategy; follower totals are account-level trajectory context and are never attributed to individual posts or posting periods.
Saved Patterns provide source evidence under the active selection contract; do not silently substitute external popularity for in-account performance when current policy forbids it.
Owner edits and deletions are evidence and lineage events; preserve them rather than hiding them from future learning.

Questions, banned families, franchise rules, preservation rules, exploration policy, current style constraints, and other active content directives belong in canonical account strategy or state, not startup.
capability_families: Foundation and performance include get_manifest_intelligence_foundation, get_performance_learning, and get_content_focus.
Cycle evidence includes get_manifest_cycle_receipt, get_manifest_cycle_analysis_page, and get_manifest_locked_lineup_page.
Strategy, preparation, and persistence use commit_manifest_cycle_strategy, prepare_manifest_autonomous_cycle, and current persist routes.
Source and generation cover source candidates, source cards, generation runs, gates, candidate drafts, and rejection memory.
Scheduling and results cover scheduled-post reads, edits, deletions, hourly coverage, post results, and published-lineage audit or recovery.

hardening_safety.load_when: Failures, blockers, regressions, repeat incidents, prevention design, idempotency ambiguity, payload failures, validation defects, or efficiency degradation.
failure_law: A real unexpected tool failure interrupts the affected objective.
Every failure occurrence leaves durable evidence; incident convergence may deduplicate identity but may not erase another occurrence.

Once raw failure evidence is durably stored in the incident, later hardening transitions carry only new transition-specific delta evidence. Do not replay raw blocked payloads, prior error text, or previously stored evidence through the client.
Diagnose exact cause, repair it, generalize the lesson, add durable prevention and regression, validate, release when required, live verify, then resume the interrupted step.
A workaround, retry, alternate target, sibling business tool, or chat note is not a fix.
Expected fail-closed control responses are boundaries to satisfy, not excuses to route around the control.
recurrence: Before novelty classification, check exact active incidents, related active incidents in the same causal family, prior closed incidents, and promoted winning paths.
An exact active repeat appends occurrence evidence to the existing incident and becomes known prevention; it is never silently discarded as a duplicate.
A related active failure class is known recurrence, not a novel failure. Continue from accumulated evidence instead of restarting diagnosis.
A repeat of a resolved failure is a prevention regression, not a fresh bug.
Prevention-regression handling starts from the prior incident, root cause, prevention, and regressions and asks why that prevention failed; strengthen or replace it before closure.

Once a winning path is verified for a failure class, compile that path as the exclusive permitted route before the next comparable action; merely naming, logging, or classifying a known recurrence does not satisfy prevention.

A prevention regression cannot close until the failed action class is replayed through the strengthened winning path and a real successful call/result verifies the route; source text, incident notes, or classification alone are insufficient closure evidence.

Causal-family generalization must remain narrow and evidence-based. OpenAI client safety pre-dispatch blocks are one family even when blocked profile or specific category wording changes; unrelated client failures remain separate.
First occurrence earns investigation and permanent prevention. Recurrence indicts the prevention or unresolved active repair path.
efficiency_incidents: Repeated fingerprints, excessive call count, or execution-duration degradation without progress can become efficiency incidents.
Efficiency means fastest complete and correct route, not fewer calls at the expense of diagnosis, validation, or durability.
Do not duplicate validations, searches, or polling when one authoritative run or read is already in progress.
transport_idempotency: An uncertain mutating transport result may be reconciled with the same stable operation identity only to establish whether execution occurred.
Never create a second operation identity merely because a response was interrupted.
Client-side schema or payload rejection means Lensically did not receive the requested operation unless tool evidence says otherwise.

commercial_product.load_when: Lensically public product surfaces, checkout, delivery, license, refund, privacy, terms, data deletion, Stripe operations, product packaging, customer delivery, or public-site ownership questions.
product_surfaces: Public customer-facing routes are owned by lensically-worker/public/ and served from lensically.com.
The private operational application is separate at app.lensically.com under lensically-web/.
Identify the owning surface before editing; never infer ownership from the domain name alone.
commerce: Stripe reads and mutations use internal typed Stripe capabilities and their source-defined protection boundaries.
Protected financial or account-ownership actions require applicable owner ratification; ordinary read-only commercial inspection does not invent approval.
Customer delivery, license, refund, privacy, and terms behavior must remain consistent with source-controlled product contracts and production verification.
product_architecture: Customer-facing copy may evolve; operator and runtime truth must still come from deployed code, canonical knowledge, and server state rather than marketing prose.
Public-site or download changes follow repository validation and the correct release path for the owning surface.

maintenance_rule: Grow the smallest relevant node. New capabilities, procedures, hazards, providers, and product details update their node or the internal typed capability registry; they never enlarge Step 0 or Step 1 and never require unrelated knowledge to be shed.
